capabilities: generate index notes listing files and subfolders
update index files on a configurable interval
format entries with emojis and bold folder names
extras: Manual installation only via GitHub Releases; no mention of the Community plugins store.
motivation: The author wanted to bring the functionality of an "auto-index" script directly into Obsidian as a native plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep an up-to-date note that lists the contents of a folder recursively.
summary: Folder indexer that automatically generates and refreshes index notes listing the files and subfolders of watched folders.
